IN  THE  HIGH  COURT OF  JUDICATURE  AT  BOMBAY

 CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION

Mayur Balasaheb Hande …. Applicant
               Versus
The State of Maharashtra and Anr. …. Respondents
-----
Mr. Rajaram Bansode a/w Mr. Mohan M. Chavan, Advocate for the
Applicant.
Ms. Veera Shinde, A.P.P., for the Respondent – State.
-----
             
        
               CORAM :   SHIVKUMAR DIGE,  J.
         DATE     :   8th SEPTEMBER, 2025.
        
P.C. : 
1. Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned A PP
for the Respondent – State.
2. Learned counsel for the Applicant submits that Applic ant
had  married  with  the  victim,  but  due  to  pressure  of  family,  the
present F.I.R. is lodged.
3. Learned APP seeks time to take instructions.
4. I  have  perused  the  F.I.R.  and  documents  produced  on
record.
Shantanu S. Dhudum                                                                                                          1/2

5. From the documents it appears that, the victim had married
with the Applicant. Considering these facts and circumst ances, I pass
following order:
ORDER
i.  In the event of arrest, the Applicant be enlarg ed on
bail in Crime No.454 of 2025 registered with Akluj
Police Station, Solapur Rural, on executing P.R. Bond
in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one or two sureties in
the like amount.
ii.  The  Applicant  shall  attend  the  concerned  police
station as and when required.
6. Issue  notice  to  the  Respondents,  returnable  on  29 th
September, 2025.
       ( SHIVKUMAR DIGE,  J.)
Shantanu S. Dhudum                                                                                                          2/2
